name: Service Elements
summary: Sydney (Gladesville) ICT/telecommunications firm: business data & telephony, hosted/managed IT and the design, build and management of FTTH networks. Associated with the Broadcast Engineering Services / E-Wire group (ACCC lists 'Service Elements / Fuze Connect / eWire / BES' together as estate-network operators).

events.details: Trading as Service Elements since c. 2000 (in business ~20 years per company); Service Elements Pty Ltd ACN 600 341 008 registered Jun 2014.
Grouped with Broadcast Engineering Services, E-Wire and Fuze Connect as one estate-network operator group (ACCC, 2012).
